points: Worked on revamping the QA stack for multiple teams. Built a GenAI platform for generating and running UI tests, using LangGraph, AWS Bedrock, and Spring Boot on Kubernetes.

organization: Centre for Career Development, NIT Calicut
points: Fine-tuned a BERT model to extract UML class diagram elements from functional requirements in SRS documents, and to detect code smells.
Annotated requirement specification documents from the PURE dataset using Label Studio.
Built a real-time image inspection application in Python with PyQt5 and OpenCV, designing the interface and leading the development.
Implemented barcode and OCR scanning, edge detection, color inspection, and distance measurement, integrated with a high-speed camera setup for live results.

points: Two-month program exploring novel applications of cellular automata.
